name: Soy bean (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Soy bean (Glycine max) [Soy] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FDC 174270 (Soybeans, mature seeds, raw; SR Legacy NDB 16108)
Zhang et al. 2022, The Crop Journal, seed soluble-sugar profiling of 1164 accessions (ScienceDirect S2214514122001192)
Song et al. 2013, Industrial Crops and Products (vegetable-soybean sugar/AA/organic-acid, S0926669013004810)
Zhu et al. 2020, Food Prod Process Nutr, doi:10.1186/s43014-020-00021-1 (organic acids by 1H NMR)
provenance.curation_notes: Raw mature soybean seed. Dominant carbon/energy sources for a growth model: sucrose (~4.5 g/100g) plus the RFOs stachyose (~1.3) and raffinose (~0.3), the large amino-acid pool (glutamate + aspartate dominant, total protein 36.5 g/100g), and oil fatty acids (linoleic dominant). Free glucose/fructose are minor. Organic acids are present (malate dominant) but low and poorly quantified for mature dry seed, so listed with null amounts. Phytic acid sequesters much of the phosphorus and chelates miner
curation_added: individual free sugars with amounts (sucrose 4.45, glucose 0.43, fructose 0.21 g/100g)
organic acids (malic dominant, plus citric, succinic, oxalic, fumaric) added qualitatively
full vitamin panel with amounts (B1-B9, C, A, E, K, choline)
major fatty acids with amounts (linoleic dominant)

curation_removed.reason: marine omega-3 (20:5 n-3); absent from soybean oil (USDA reports none). FooDB predicted/implausible

curation_removed.reason: preformed (animal) vitamin A; plants contain provitamin-A carotenoids, not retinol

curation_removed.name: Gadoleic acid
curation_removed.reason: 20:1 gondoic acid; only ultratrace in soybean oil, not a meaningful nutrient

curation_removed.name: Heptadecanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: odd-chain 17:0; ultratrace, ruminant/dairy marker, not a soybean nutrient of note

curation_removed.name: Pentadecanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: odd-chain 15:0; ultratrace dairy marker, not a soybean nutrient of note

curation_removed.name: Dodecanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: lauric 12:0; not present at meaningful levels in soybean oil

curation_removed.name: Heptanoate
curation_removed.reason: C7 fatty acid; not a genuine soybean-seed component (FooDB noise)

curation_removed.name: Maltose C12H22O11
curation_removed.reason: not a native free sugar of raw soybean seed (arises only on malting/hydrolysis); soy free sugars are sucrose + RFOs

curation_removed.name: Starch C12H20O10
curation_removed.reason: mature soybean seed stores oil/protein, not starch (<1 g/100g); negligible for growth

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
